# delord.dev

Personal site of Evan DeLord, a platform engineer working on cloud infrastructure
and the careful measurement of AI coding agents. The site collects project work
(/work), research notes on AI agents (/research), and occasional essays (/essays).
Static Astro site, no trackers, fonts self-hosted; source on GitHub (edd426).
Contact and profiles: https://github.com/edd426 and https://www.linkedin.com/in/eddelord.
